title: [BUG] Unable to use Claude Code, console.anthropic.com is preventing me from changing my usage, I am admin
body:
As per my prior bug, https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/1047, I am unable to use Claude Code. 

It has now been over 2 weeks and I have not received any resolution. I know you are busy with other bugs, but there are multiple other users reporting the same error.

Why am I artificially capped to $10 of usage per month with Claude Code? 

Please fix this, if it is not resolved, then I have no use nor desire to continue paying $200/mo for the MAX plan.

Thank you in advance for your support.
author: murflaw7424
